extension_rule.scope: First action-current scope in the original locked order that returns a validated graph with at least one eligible unassessed person, regardless of whether it yields an automatic group.
extension_rule.person: Among eligible unassessed people, highest maximum cosine to that initial scope interpretation contribution query, using its existing exact document/query vectors; tie by canonical person ID ascending. No extra query or model to select the person.
extension_rule.already_assessed: Excluded; extension reuses unchanged cached stages.

check_rule: Unchanged input-lock-v1: deterministic primary groups for first two ready graph-producing distinct source groups in original order, at most one group/every-member and one explanation request per group. Never substitute after grades.
currentness: Fresh authoritative action clock for each interaction and executor start. Historical fixed comparison clock does not authorize an expired live request.
runtime_checks: ordinary startup has no team request
option switch and ordinary edits: zero provider requests
actual graph package/heap/cold-warm timings without forced garbage collection
prior_full_browser_evidence: Preserved 117-case run plus four focused corrections; repeat only affected integration checks.
